decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted   therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - The access doorway to the school shall have a minimum clear width of 900mm, a level surface or ramp between the pavement and the floor and a door handle of not more than 1m above ground level.

Condition : 5 - 5.	No development shall take place until full details have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority, for a scheme of reducing carbon emissions by 20%, where feasible, from the total energy needs (heat, cooling and power) of the development by the on-site generation of renewable energy. The details shall be carried out as approved.

Condition : 6 - 6.	The drop-off/collection area shall be made available for use before the extensions are first used and shall be made permanently available for the drop-off and collection of pupils attending the school unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 7 - The Travel Plan received 30/03/2011 shall be fully complied with in all regards unless otherwise agreed in writing beforehand by the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of a single storey extension linking the Junior School and Infant School buildings to provide six classrooms, a staff room, a resource room and welfare facilities, and erection of single storey extensions to the Junior school building and the Nursery building with roof alterations to the Nursery.
